notes: All mutation runs compiled the real production Gomad library graph, selected exactly one named Rust test and observed numeric exit101 plus test failure. No separate test-only scheduler implementation was used.

A mutation that disables an early graph invariant can expose a later invariant panic; such a panic is only mutant-kill evidence. Original malformed inputs must and do take the intended typed refusal in the restored test, with exception-free valid controls.

Budgeted/heavy ready-selection prefilter shares its running-heavy guarantee with can_start at the same admission boundary. Independent budgeted_heavy refusal/control and heavy_ready selection mutation protect both situations.

Actual critical-path empty-case is represented by an empty finished-record iterator. Its source countermutation removes the empty fallback and fails the empty-run fixture; no completion is fabricated.
Original topological completed/active branches fold into one validated graph traversal with separate diamond and cycle fixtures.
